title: 第11章 地火种子第12章 熔炼地火龙暝和商红雪正式见面
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: 陈渊打趣道：“真的，我看红雪这丫头各方面都比她姐姐要好，而且，这个丫头对你有好感，你或许可以考虑一下红雪这个丫头，你母亲和我都很喜欢红雪这个丫头，你们在一起的话，或许会更好。”
两人差不多，半斤八两，都不是特别出色的天才，凑在一起，是最好的选择。
陈渊也很喜欢商红雪这个儿媳妇，能够当自己儿媳妇的话，自然是最好，红雪那丫头温柔善良，性格也很好，各方面都很契合陈初阳，简直就是量身为他定做的妻子，这样的女人要是丢弃了，可就真的亏大了。
身为父亲，他自然也要为自己的未来着想，龙蛇城的合适女孩子他都有所留意，一方面是为了给自己的大儿子找到合适的妻子，另一方面，自然是为了陈初阳。
两个儿子都到了娶亲的年龄，都需要物色好女孩，性格，脾性，还是各方面都需要考虑，陈初升的话，考虑的事情多一点，也没那么容易成。
倒是陈初阳这个小儿子，很好成，没那么多考量，也无需在意太多，基本上，他看上的女孩子，没有太大问题的话，有很大概率会成的，他们陈家的地位和实力摆在这里，哪怕陈初阳是个普通人，可也是那些人高攀的存在。
商家，始终是个最好的选择，商红雪，是最为合适的。
“父亲，红雪还小。”
“不小了，事情可以定下来，等到两三年后再举办婚礼，照样可以，正好那时候你也成熟了。”
陈渊有一点想法，那就是自己的儿子刚好到了年龄，还不是很成熟，可以等两三年，比起商红尘，商红雪太适合了。
陈初阳没有问题的话，他可以去问问商应年的口风，说不定成了呢。
“孩儿暂时没成亲的想法。”
陈渊注视着儿子的眼神，许久，他没有继续说这个话题。
而是岔开话题。
“初阳，你让为父打听的消息有了。”
陈初阳眼神跳动，闪烁一抹兴奋。
“龙蛇城之外确实有地火的痕迹，就在龙蛇城之外，龙蛇山的北边。”
“距离这里大概几十里的地方，有一座山峰，那一座山峰下，酝酿着一口地火。”
“只是那地方不安全，乃是龙蛇城的绝地之一。”
“而且，那口地火充满了煞气，难以吸收。”
地火，天地之火。
存在于山脉之下，属于是大地之火，诞生于大地，所以地火拥有着浓郁的煞气，地脉煞气对修炼者有着距离的危害，稍微碰一点，无法祛除，轻则修为降低，重则，身死道消。
而且，地火的危害不仅于此，火焰温度高，周围被地火所覆盖，形成了一个相对危险的绝地，凝丹以下踏足这个领域，都会被地火焚烧殆尽。
一缕小小的地火，足以焚灭所有凝丹以下的修炼者。
更不要说那一座山的地火，威力吓人。
“你如果想要收集地火，为父劝你最好不要去，那地方不是你能靠近的。”
“地火之外的一里地都是绝地，凡是靠近之人，都要经历地火的炙烤。”
“最为恐怖的是地火之中的煞气，那才是最要命的，一旦真气被煞气附着，后果不堪设想。”
地火的危害，不仅仅是针对人类。
所有靠近的人，都会被地火所焚烧。
不分你我。
“我知道，父亲。”
陈初阳点点头，他自然知道地火的危害，也知道地火的恐怖。
content_en:
Chen Yuan joked: "Really, I think this girl Hongxue is better than her sister in every aspect. Moreover, this girl has a crush on you. You might want to consider this girl Hongxue. Your mother and I both like this girl Hongxue. It might be better if you two are together."
The two of them are almost the same, neither of them are particularly outstanding geniuses, so getting together is the best choice.
Chen Yuan also likes Shang Hongxue as his daughter-in-law. It would be best if she could be his daughter-in-law. That girl Hongxue is gentle and kind, and has a good personality. She suits Chen Chuyang in every aspect. She is simply a wife tailor-made for him. If such a woman is discarded, it will be a big loss.
As a father, he naturally has to think about his future. He pays attention to suitable girls in Dragon Snake City. On the one hand, it is to find a suitable wife for his eldest son, and on the other hand, it is naturally for Chen Chuyang.
Both sons have reached the age of marriage, and both need to consider a good girl's character, temperament, and other aspects. If Chen Chusheng has more things to consider, it will not be so easy.
On the other hand, Chen Chuyang, the younger son, is very successful. He doesn't have to think too much, and he doesn't need to care too much. Basically, if there are no big problems with the girl he likes, there is a high probability that he will succeed. The status and strength of their Chen family are here. Even if Chen Chuyang is an ordinary person, he is one of those people who are high up on him.
Merchant is always the best choice, and Shang Hongxue is the most suitable.
"Father, Hongxue is still young."
"It's not too young. You can settle the matter and hold the wedding in two or three years. It's still fine. You will be mature by then."
Chen Yuan has an idea, that is, his son has just reached the age and is not very mature yet. He can wait for two or three years. Compared with Shang Hongchen, Shang Hongxue is too suitable.
If Chen Chuyang has no problem, he can ask Shang Yingnian for advice, and maybe it will work out.
"My child has no intention of getting married for the time being."
Chen Yuan looked at his son's eyes. For a long time, he did not continue to talk about this topic.
But change the subject.
"Chu Yang, you let me find out the news for my father."
"Oh?"
Chen Chuyang's eyes twitched, flashing with excitement.
"There are indeed traces of ground fire outside Dragon Snake City, just outside Dragon Snake City and to the north of Dragon Snake Mountain."
"There is a mountain peak about dozens of miles away from here. Under that mountain peak, there is an earth fire brewing."
"It's just that that place is not safe. It is one of the most dangerous places in Dragon Snake City."
"Moreover, that mouthful of earthly fire is full of evil spirits and is difficult to absorb."
Fire of earth, fire of heaven and earth.
It exists under the mountains. It belongs to the fire of the earth and was born from the earth. Therefore, the fire of the earth has a strong evil spirit. The evil spirit of the earth veins has a long-distance harm to the cultivator. If it is touched even slightly, it cannot be eliminated. In the slightest, the cultivation level will be reduced, and in the worst case, the body will die and the path will disappear.
Moreover, the dangers of the earth fire are not limited to this. The flame temperature is high and the surrounding area is covered by the earth fire, forming a relatively dangerous place. Anyone who sets foot in this area will be burned to death by the earth fire.
A small wisp of earth fire is enough to incinerate all cultivators below the level of Ningdan.
Not to mention the terrifying power of the ground fire on that mountain.
"If you want to collect earth fire, my father advises you not to go. You can't get close to that place."
"One mile beyond the Earth Fire is a dangerous place. Anyone who comes close will experience the scorching heat of the Earth Fire."
"The most terrifying thing is the evil spirit in the earth fire. That is the most deadly. Once the true energy is attached to the evil spirit, the consequences will be disastrous."
The dangers of ground fires are not just for humans.
Anyone who comes near will be burned by the fire.
No distinction between you and me.
"I know, Father."
Chen Chuyang nodded. He naturally knew the dangers of underground fire and the terror of underground fire.
title_en: Chapter 11 Earth Fire Seed Chapter 12 Smelting Earth Fire Long Ming and Shang Hongxue officially meet
